dedupe_keys.name: influence of the road profile accuracy on the performance of disturbance compensation in active suspension systems

description: Influence of the road profile accuracy on the performance of disturbance compensation in active suspension systems is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by open.bydata. This dataset contains the results of simulations of linear and non-linear quarter vehicle models with an active suspension system travelling on different road profiles. Three different disturbance feedforward controls were used to control the active suspension, assuming the road profile is known in advance. Coverage: open.bydata. The portal files it under the publisher open.bydata. Its tags are active-suspensions, disturbance-feedforward-control, quarter-vehicle, ride-comfort, ride-safety. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
